diagnosis: The lone decision-maker was able to satisfy checks C1, C3, and C5 because the rollout settlements matched the required assignments and commitments without needing the hidden information. Specifically, the float RN was assigned to oncology and the per-diem CNA to medical-surgical, aligning with PF1 and PF2, which were never accessible to the lone decision-maker.

C1.why: The finalized infusion schedule changes the float RN assignment to oncology, fixes the coverage window at 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM, and requires an oncology infusion-monitoring commitment.

C3.why: The lift-equipment replacement window changes the per-diem CNA assignment to medical-surgical, fixes it at 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM, and requires a commitment covering that replacement-window assignment.

C5.why: The finalized infusion schedule changes the float RN assignment to oncology, fixes the coverage window at 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM, and requires an oncology infusion-monitoring commitment.
